name: Boston Marathon 2026
description: The Boston Marathon is the world's oldest annual marathon and one of the most prestigious road racing events. Held on Patriots' Day in April, the point-to-point course from Hopkinton to downtown Boston is legendary for the Heartbreak Hill series and the electric finish on Boylston Street. A qualifying time is required to enter.

name: Tokyo Marathon 2026
description: The Tokyo Marathon is a World Marathon Major held in the heart of Japan's capital city. Runners pass iconic landmarks including Tokyo Tower, Asakusa, and the Imperial Palace. The lottery-based entry draws hundreds of thousands of applicants each year for one of Asia's most celebrated races.
